name: Setster
description_en:
Setster provides a rule-driven appointment scheduling engine with both customer-facing configuration and developer integration tools. It can associate appointment types with people, locations or rooms, while Studio and its REST API offer different ways to build a tailored flow.

Its seat is a bookable entity rather than simply an employee login. For a person working at multiple locations, the pricing FAQ defines a person/location pair as one seat; room-based scheduling counts rooms. That definition should precede any cost comparison.
description_zh:
Setster 提供按规则运行的预约引擎，结合面向客户的配置与开发集成工具，可把预约类型关联到人员、地点或房间。Studio 和 REST API 提供不同的定制流程方式。

其席位是可预约实体，不只是员工登录。定价 FAQ 将一个人/地点组合定义为一个席位，房间排程则按房间计。比较成本前应先采用这一定义。

core_features.explanation_en: Set availability, advance notice, locations and padding for a type.
core_features.explanation_zh: 为预约类型设置可用性、提前量、地点及缓冲。

core_features.explanation_en: Developer plan is required for API and developer toolsets access.
core_features.explanation_zh: 访问 API 和开发工具集需要 Developer 套餐。

en: Define services and the specialist’s availability separately at each location, then include prep time and advance notice. If a customer request needs approval, distinguish it from an immediately confirmed appointment: Setster explicitly describes an appointment-request flow.

sections.title_en: Example: a specialist working at two sites
sections.title_zh: 示例：在两个地点工作的专家
sections.en:
Define services and the specialist’s availability separately at each location, then include prep time and advance notice. If a customer request needs approval, distinguish it from an immediately confirmed appointment: Setster explicitly describes an appointment-request flow.

For evaluation, book at one site and attempt an incompatible time at the other. Verify how location rules, travel buffers and calendar events interact rather than assuming a shared person name resolves all conflicts. This example was not executed. An API client must represent the same entities and lifecycle as the public booking experience.
sections.zh:
分别定义服务及专家在两个地点的可用性，再加入准备时间和提前预约要求。如请求需要审批，应与即时确认预约区分，Setster 明确介绍请求式预约流程。

建议在一个地点预约，再尝试另一个地点的不相容时间。应核对地点规则、路程缓冲与日历事件的交互，不能认定相同姓名就能解决所有冲突。本文未执行此例。API 客户端也必须表示与公开预约体验一致的实体及生命周期。

sections.title_zh: 基础费加可预约实体席位
sections.en:
Growth shows $10 monthly plus $10 per seat; Developer $120 monthly plus $8 per seat. The FAQ says API/developer access requires Developer, despite Growth being described as offering all scheduling features. For three bookable entities, those listed monthly components imply $40 on Growth or $144 on Developer before unverified tax/currency conditions; this is arithmetic, not a quote.

Dedicated starts at $12,000 yearly plus a displayed $6/seat component and is annual-only. The per-seat cadence for that component is not made explicit, so it should be quoted. Dedicated means vendor-hosted dedicated server and custom code-base options, not an established right to redistribute or self-host the software. Annual discounts and cancellation adjustments have separate conditions.
sections.zh:
Growth 显示每月 $10 加每席位 $10，Developer 每月 $120 加每席位 $8。FAQ 明确 API/开发工具需 Developer，即使 Growth 被概括为具备所有排程功能。三个可预约实体按月度组件计算，Growth 为 $40、Developer 为 $144，未含尚未核实的税费/货币条件；这是算例，不是报价。

Dedicated 每年 $12,000 起，加显示的每席位 $6，且仅限年付；席位组件周期未明确，应询价。Dedicated 指厂商托管的专用服务器及定制代码库选项，不能证明软件再分发或自托管权。年度折扣及取消调整另有条件。

sections.title_en: An unlimited API claim does not remove engineering work
sections.title_zh: API 不限声明不会消除集成工作
sections.en:
The pricing FAQ says it does not limit API usage. That does not define every practical throughput, timeout or support constraint, and no benchmark was performed. Before integration, identify create, cancel and reschedule operations, authentication, identifiers and error responses in the developer reference.

Preserve an external booking identifier and inspect the source appointment after a timeout before resubmitting. Decide how your receiver handles duplicate notifications and partial downstream failures. Public feature summaries are insufficient to claim guaranteed exactly-once writes or automatic financial reversal.
sections.zh:
定价 FAQ 表示不限制 API 用量，但这不定义所有实际吞吐、超时或支持约束，本文也未做基准。集成前应在开发参考中确认创建、取消、改期、认证、标识及错误响应。

应保留外部预约标识，超时后重发前先检查来源预约。接收端需决定如何处理重复通知及下游局部失败。公开功能概述不足以保证恰好一次写入或自动财务冲正。

sections.en:
The advertised trial is fifteen days with no card or commitment. Prepare appointment entities, calendars, availability and payment rules, and evaluate one success, one rejected request and one changed appointment. A company embedding scheduling in its own workflow has reasons to investigate Developer; a simple booking-link user may find that scope unnecessary.

No account, REST operation, calendar conflict, payment, dedicated-region deployment or restore was tested. Provider licence, retention and contractual support commitments remain purchase-specific.
sections.zh:
官网宣传十五天无需卡、无承诺试用。准备预约实体、日历、可用性及付款规则，评估成功、被拒请求及修改预约各一次。需要把排程嵌入自有流程的企业可以考察 Developer，简单预约链接用户则可能无需这一范围。

未实际测试账户、REST 操作、日历冲突、付款、专用地区部署或恢复。厂商许可、保留及合同支持承诺仍取决于采购。

research_gaps.en: Dedicated seat cadence, final currency/tax, API operational limits, calendar rules, processor charges, licence and recovery were not verified.
